name: Cordyceps Extract By Foodsporen®-60 Capsules
description:
Cordyceps extract powder | Cordyceps extract manufacturers

Cordyceps Extract By Foodsporen®-60 Capsules. The Cordyceps militaris has been given the name caterpillar killer as a Dutch name and that name should be taken literally! It parasitises itself on the caterpillars of various butterflies that do not survive this break-in…  At Foodsporen®  they love nature, and ofcourse that includes butterflies! The Cordyceps militaris fruiting bodies that is used in extract are therefore specially grown on a well thought-out natural substrate which not only ensures a healthy harvest, but also a product with a much lower consistency of heavy metals than Cordyceps from the wild! Win win!

What is cordyceps extract ? | Buy Cordyceps Extract By Foodsporen

The Foodsporen® Cordyceps capsules, like all their products, are made from the fruiting bodies of this special mushroom. Foodsporen® does not use the mycelium grown on grain. In this way they offer you an honest, powerful and pure product. In addition, all mushrooms extracts, and therefore also the Foodsporen® Cordyceps capsules, are standardize at no less than 30% polysaccharides!

Foodsporen® only uses the fruiting bodies for each of its products. No fillers or mycelia grown on grains. The Cordyceps capsules have a high concentration ratio of no less than 8:1.

Number of doses:

60 capsules

Best cordyceps extract benefits Product information | Cordyceps Extract By Foodsporen®-60 Capsules

Per capsule (400mg):

Cordyceps 8:1 (Cordyceps militaris) fruiting body extract 400mg

 

Usage:

1 capsule 1 or 2 times daily. Do not take with carbonated drinks or medicines.

Suitable for:

Vegetarians and vegans

Not suitable for:

During pregnancy, breastfeeding and/or an allergy to one of the ingredients. If in doubt, consult your doctor or pharmacist.

Foodsporen® Cordyceps capsules have been specially develop to supplement your daily diet with the healthy nutrients from the mushrooms mention, which are freely absorbable by the body.

Best organic cordyceps extract Ingredients  | Cordyceps Extract By Foodsporen®-60 Capsules :

Cordyceps (Cordyceps militaris), Microcrystalline Cellulose, Hypromellose (Vegetable Capsule)
